title: 💰 California summons Nvidia to investigate its chips reaching China!
body: 💰 California summons Nvidia to investigate its chips reaching China!

California Attorney General Rob Bonta issued a formal investigative subpoena to Nvidia on Thursday, November 19, as part of an investigation into whether advanced AI chips or secret information reached China, and whether the company misled investors and the public about these risks. The subpoena came days after the resignation of the company's former CEO, Jensen Huang, amid federal investigations into chip exports, while Huang agreed to testify before Congress in December. A House committee revealed that the U.S. administration approved shipping about 900,000 advanced AI chips from Nvidia and another company to Chinese firms between December 2025 and May 2026, and that the company sought approval to sell more than 40,000 'H200' chips to a company linked to the case. The company appointed its CFO, Colette Kress, as interim CEO, while the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission runs a separate investigation.

Simply put: America bans the most powerful AI chips from reaching China under strict export laws; and California is now asking: did these chips leak despite the ban, and did the company hide the risk from its investors?
Do you trust that export restrictions really prevent advanced technology from getting through?
